summary: This sermon teaches that church unity is built on individual spiritual maturity, which comes from fixing our eyes on Jesus who perfectly balances truth and love. The preacher warns against two false teachings that distract believers: religion (truth without love) and postmodernism (love without truth), both of which prevent genuine spiritual growth and unity.
key_points: Individual spiritual maturity leads to corporate church unity
Spiritual maturity means obedience to Jesus, not just intellectual knowledge
Two false teachings distract from maturity: truth without love and love without truth
Jesus is the perfect balance of truth and love, displayed at the cross
As individuals become like Jesus, the church becomes unified and reflects Christ
big_idea: Individual spiritual maturity, achieved by fixing our eyes on Jesus who perfectly balances truth and love, leads to genuine church unity.
title: A Unified Church
